 여기를 클릭하여 Shopify와 함께 지금 온라인 판매를 시작하세요.   무료 체험 시작하기 무료 체험 시작하기 Kohepets simplifies loyalty at checkout with Shopify Plus
 For Singapore pet retailer Kohepets , keeping customers coming back is central to their growth strategy. Over the years, Shopify has helped the business scale their online store and connect sales across multiple channels, including Shopee, Lazada and TikTok. With around 65% of sales coming through their own, branded website, creating a convenient, rewarding shopping experience remains a priority.
 Having built a strong ecommerce foundation on Shopify, Kohepets saw an opportunity to take their customer experience further with Shopify Plus. In particular, the team wanted to make their existing loyalty programme easier to use, removing the need for customers to exchange points for vouchers before completing their purchases.
 With Shopify Plus, Kohepets can now offer direct loyalty points redemption at checkout and introduce product recommendations later in the buying journey. These capabilities support their ongoing optimisation strategy, with Shopify Analytics also showing higher store conversion, total sales and order volumes across the reported comparison periods.
 Within six months of moving to Shopify Plus, Kohepets saw:
 8% relative increase in store conversion rate
 14% higher total sales
 15% more orders
 The challenge: Making loyalty easier to use 
 Pet retail is built around repeat purchasing, with customers regularly returning for food, supplies and other essentials. For Kohepets, creating a shopping experience that keeps customers happy and encourages them to return has always been a priority. 
 Shopify had already provided the foundation for Kohepets to scale their ecommerce business. After moving from Magento years earlier, the retailer no longer needed to manage their own servers or website infrastructure. As the business expanded across marketplaces, Shopify also became a central hub for collecting orders, with an existing third-party integration synchronising product listings, inventory and order statuses across channels. 
 With these foundations in place, Kohepets turned their attention to improving the customer journey, particularly how shoppers could use loyalty rewards at checkout. 
 The retailer had developed their own loyalty programme after finding that the cost of a third-party service increased as order volumes grew. Customers earned points that could be exchanged for vouchers and applied to purchases. However, combining these vouchers with tiered pricing and mix-and-match promotions sometimes created restrictions and required technical workarounds. 
 These workarounds did not always behave as expected. Occasionally, customers would report that their discounts had not been applied correctly, creating friction in an experience designed to reward their loyalty. 
 Kohepets also wanted to build on their existing cross-selling and upselling capabilities by introducing more relevant product recommendations at checkout. 
 The team had regularly considered Shopify’s Plus tier during business reviews. With their ecommerce operations already running successfully on Shopify, the decision came down to whether additional checkout flexibility could deliver enough value to justify the increased investment. 
 Shopify has helped us scale without worrying about managing servers or website speed. With Shopify Plus, we wanted to take that further and see what more we could do with the checkout experience.
 Kohepets
 Ang Kim Heong — Founder 
 The solution: Bringing loyalty into checkout 
 Upgrading to Shopify Plus gave Kohepets greater flexibility to customise checkout around their customers' needs, while building on the ecommerce systems and processes they already had in place. 
 One of the most valuable changes was integrating loyalty points redemption directly into checkout. Using the Shopify Checkout customisation capabilities in Shopify Plus, Kohepets enabled customers to apply their existing loyalty points to purchases without first exchanging them for vouchers. 
 The change removes an extra step from the purchasing journey, making loyalty rewards easier and more convenient to use. It also gives Kohepets more control over how their loyalty programme works within checkout, helping the team move away from the voucher-based workarounds that previously complicated certain promotions. 
 Switching to Shopify Plus helped us resolve the loyalty issue. Customers can now use their points directly at checkout instead of redeeming vouchers first. That reduces friction and creates a better experience.
 Kohepets
 Ang Kim Heong — Founder 
 Kohepets is also using checkout customisation to extend their approach to cross-selling and upselling. 
 The retailer already offered product recommendations in their shopping cart. With Shopify Plus, the team can bring these recommendations into checkout, creating another opportunity to introduce customers to relevant products before they complete their purchases. 
 This remains an area of active optimisation. Kohepets is conducting A/B tests to improve the relevance of recommendations, experimenting with different approaches and allowing tests to run longer where necessary to gather more reliable results. 
 Beyond the customer-facing experience, Shopify Plus also provides additional API capacity for Kohepets' connected workflows. Shopify continues to collect orders from their online store and marketplaces, while Airtable supports order processing and invoicing. Increased API headroom gives the team more flexibility when running occasional batch jobs and scripts that previously encountered usage limits. 
 Kohepets also values having access to a Shopify contact who can provide another perspective on optimisation opportunities alongside their existing technical contractor. 
 Together, these capabilities allow the retailer to keep improving their online shopping experience without replacing the systems that already support their business. Rather than competing primarily through deep discounts on marketplaces, Kohepets is investing in convenience, customer trust and a smoother purchasing journey to encourage shoppers to return directly to their website. 
 The results: A smoother checkout and continued growth 
 With Shopify Plus, Kohepets has simplified loyalty redemption while gaining more flexibility to optimise the customer experience. 
 Customers can now use their loyalty points directly at checkout, removing the separate voucher conversion process. The retailer can also experiment with product recommendations later in the purchasing journey, creating more opportunities to refine how customers discover and buy products. 
 Store conversion increased from 7.86% to 8.49% between Kohepets’ March–April and May–June 2026 reporting periods, representing an 8% relative improvement. Total sales increased by 14% in the six months following the upgrade to Shopify Plus.
 For Kohepets, the key value of Shopify Plus lies in the ability to keep building on their established ecommerce foundation. By making loyalty benefits easier to use and continuing to test new checkout experiences, the retailer can focus on creating the kind of shopping journey that encourages customers to return. 
 With Shopify Plus, it's about setting realistic expectations and finding ways to maximise the additional capabilities. For us, the focus is on improving the customer experience and giving customers more reasons to keep coming back.
 Kohepets
 Ang Kim Heong — Founder 
 Looking ahead, Kohepets plans to continue refining their checkout experience and exploring new opportunities to grow. With Shopify Plus supporting the next stage of their ecommerce strategy, the business can keep investing in the customer relationships that have been central to their success. 
 With Shopify Plus, Kohepets saw results fast:
 8% relative increase in store conversion rate
 14% higher total sales
 15% more orders
